stories.headline: MKBHD Reviews iPhone 18 Pro
stories.summary: The latest iPhone 18 Pro review highlights the monumental shift driven by its new chip architecture. Marques Brownlee breaks down how processing power and silicon advancements dictate the phone's overall capability. Performance metrics and thermal management take center stage in this generation's hardware evaluation.

stories.headline: Breaking Down Four Recent NBA Contract Extensions
stories.summary: Salary cap analyst Yossi Gozlan and NBA writer Sam Quinn examine the financial details and strategic implications of four player extensions finalized over the past few days. The episode provides a comprehensive look at how these new deals impact team payrolls and future roster flexibility under the current CBA.

stories.headline: Pat Riley's Blunt Mandate Sparks Conditioning Overhaul for Heat's Mitchell
stories.summary: Miami Heat president Pat Riley skipped standard basketball talk during exit meetings to issue a strict demand: Mitchell had to cut his body fat after failing the prior year's conditioning test. The forward revealed on the 'Deuce and Mo' podcast that he embraced the mandate and has already dropped significant weight heading into training camp. The broader league digest also highlights coaching adjustments for Steve Kerr's Golden State staff and key roster extensions in Detroit and Utah.

stories.headline: The Theological Parallel of Cancer
stories.summary: This essay explores spiritual and theological themes by drawing an analogy to cellular behavior in cancer. It examines how destructive patterns mirror moral decay within human communities and institutions. The piece bridges modern scientific concepts with traditional Christian teachings on faith and restoration.

stories.headline: Mastering the Volleyball Jump Float Serve
stories.summary: The jump float serve relies on a precise three-step approach and a low, controlled toss to generate unpredictable ball movement. By striking the middle of the ball with a flat, firm palm and avoiding a wrist snap, players create a spin-free trajectory that drops quickly. Coaches emphasize jumping straight up rather than forward to meet the ball at the peak of your reach.

stories.headline: New Orleans Pelicans 2026 Offseason and Salary Cap Breakdown
stories.summary: Salary cap analyst Yossi Gozlan teams up with Jake Madison to review the New Orleans Pelicans' 2026 offseason moves. The episode breaks down the team's financial maneuvering and salary cap implications following recent transactions.

stories.headline: Offseason NBA News Round-Up Analyzes Trades, Lineups, and Front Office Shifts
stories.summary: Basketball Intelligence's latest briefing rounds up critical offseason storylines across the NBA ahead of the 2026-27 season. Highlights include Brandon Weems' appointment as Cavaliers GM, the aftermath of Minnesota's long-sought LaMelo Ball acquisition, and lineup adjustments in Dallas and Phoenix. Other coverage explores Boston's roster margins, defensive impact metrics in Oklahoma City, and offensive rankings across the league.

stories.headline: Daniel Jones Seeks Primetime Redemption Against Chiefs
stories.summary: Quarterback Daniel Jones enters Sunday Night Football carrying a notoriously poor career record in primetime games. He will have a chance to reverse that narrative when his squad faces off against the Kansas City Chiefs.

stories.headline: Week 2 NFL Takeaways: Bengals Shine While Key QBs Suffer Injuries
stories.summary: The Cincinnati Bengals put together a cohesive team performance in Week 2, while the Chicago Bears struggled after losing Caleb Williams. Meanwhile, injuries to starting quarterbacks further complicated the outlook for teams like the Washington Commanders.

stories.headline: Early NFL Overreactions: Is Tyler Shough New Orleans' Answer?
stories.summary: Week 2 sparks familiar early-season panics and hot takes across the league, including questions about whether Tyler Shough is the right fit in New Orleans. Analysts are also debating if the Minnesota Vikings deserve to be early favorites in the NFC North.

stories.headline: Sunday Night Football DFS Advice: Chiefs vs. Colts Lineup Picks
stories.summary: Building a winning daily Fantasy lineup for the Sunday Night Football matchup between the Chiefs and Colts requires finding the right value plays and core stacks. This breakdown offers targeted advice to optimize your DFS roster for the primetime showdown.

stories.headline: Navigating Grief When Loved Ones Depart for Missionary Work
stories.summary: The Gospel Coalition offers theological guidance and emotional support for individuals experiencing the painful separation of loved ones leaving for the mission field. The essay collection and related resources explore how believers can process profound grief while maintaining faith. It addresses the unique intersection of spiritual calling and personal heartache.

stories.headline: Kentucky Rallies Past Louisville to Take 2-1 Lead
stories.summary: No. 4 Kentucky overcame a sluggish start against No. 3 Louisville at Historic Memorial Coliseum, dropping the opening set before bouncing back with 29-27 and 25-21 wins. Brooklyn DeLeye anchored the offensive surge with 18 kills as the Wildcats grabbed a crucial advantage in the five-set battle.

stories.headline: Anaheim, Omaha, and Orlando Named Host Cities for 2027 Women's Volleyball World Cup
stories.summary: The FIVB has selected Anaheim, Omaha, and Orlando as the initial U.S. host venues for the 32-team 2027 Women's Volleyball World Cup, which also serves as an LA28 Olympic qualifier. The Honda Center in Anaheim will stage the tournament's final rounds, while ION is slated to provide 17 days of national television coverage.

stories.headline: GM Reverses Course to Bring Apple CarPlay Back to 2027 Trucks
stories.summary: General Motors is walking back its controversial decision to strip Apple CarPlay from its newer vehicles by introducing a redesigned infotainment layout for the 2027 Chevrolet Silverado and GMC Sierra. The updated 60-inch digital display allows smartphone projection apps to run alongside native vehicle controls like fuel levels and towing data.

stories.headline: Google Introduces AX for Scaling Agentic Workloads
stories.summary: Google's new Open Agentic Orchestrator, AX, provides a declarative framework to run billions of AI agent tasks in isolated sandboxes. The tool utilizes four core primitives—Task, Workspace, Gateway, and Model—to manage network policies, Git repositories, and state securely.

stories.headline: Developer Achieves Byte-Identical Decompilation of Resident Evil 4
stories.summary: A developer has successfully released a complete, byte-identical C/C++ decompilation of the GameCube debug build of Resident Evil 4. The project maps out all 15,641 functions and builds exact replicas of the main executable and all 114 REL overlays.

stories.headline: Revisiting the Countercultural Sound of 'Easy Rider'
stories.summary: Pitchfork examines the enduring cultural footprint of the 1969 biker film soundtrack. The review explores how the album's iconic tracks capture the tension between utopian hippie idealism and darker, self-destructive impulses of the era.

stories.headline: US and Denmark Secure Greenland Security Pact Following Trump Threats
stories.summary: The United States and Denmark have reached an agreement on Greenland's defense, ending months of friction sparked by President Trump's threats to seize the territory. Slated for formal signing next week at the UN General Assembly, the pact guarantees permanent US security oversight while protecting Greenlandic self-determination and barring foreign adversaries from the region. NATO officials have welcomed the diplomatic resolution to the Arctic sovereignty dispute.

stories.headline: Fantasy Football Panic Meter: Week 3 Waiver Wire and Buy-Low Targets
stories.summary: Fantasy managers facing early-season buyer's remorse can look to Week 3 waiver wire additions to patch up struggling rosters. This week's panic meter highlights early risers and fallers to help you decide who to buy, sell, or drop.

stories.headline: Massive Ukrainian Drone Barrage Hits Moscow and Russian Infrastructure
stories.summary: Ukrainian forces launched more than 1,000 drones across Russia overnight in an unprecedented swarm that sent hundreds of unmanned craft straight toward Moscow during the final day of Kremlin parliamentary voting. Officials confirmed two deaths and 20 injuries across the wider Moscow region, alongside strikes that caused damage to an oil refinery and a residential building. Moscow's mayor characterized the incursion as the largest aerial assault on the capital to date.

stories.headline: Financial Queries Often Baffle AI Chatbots
stories.summary: A recent report highlights that artificial intelligence chatbots frequently deliver incorrect answers when handling financial queries. The findings raise concerns about relying on automated tools for crucial money-related guidance.

stories.headline: NFL Week 2 Grades: Saints Ace Ravens While Steelers Struggle
stories.summary: The latest NFL power rankings and team grades for Week 2 highlight a standout performance by the New Orleans Saints in their upset against the Baltimore Ravens. Meanwhile, other franchises like the Pittsburgh Steelers earned much lower marks for their early-season outings.

stories.headline: Simon Willison Releases llm-keys-ui 0.1 for Managing API Keys
stories.summary: Developer Simon Willison has released llm-keys-ui 0.1, a lightweight web interface designed to configure API keys on remote machines. The tool allows users running coding agents via Codex to safely input keys without pasting them directly into chat applications.

stories.headline: Simon Willison Ships datasette-auth-github 1.0 Following Session Fix
stories.summary: Simon Willison bumped the datasette-auth-github plugin to version 1.0 after solving an issue with prematurely expiring user sessions. The bug occurred because authentication cookies lacked a Max-Age parameter, triggering abrupt logouts on browsers like Mobile Safari. With that patch merged, the release marks formal stability across both Datasette 0.65.x and Datasette 1.0ax.

stories.headline: Samsung Expected to More Than Double HBM4 Chip Output Next Year
stories.summary: Samsung Electronics plans to ramp up production of its sixth-generation HBM4 and seventh-generation HBM4E memory chips significantly next year. To support thinner wafer processing for these high-stack components, the company is increasing its outsourced glass carrier volume to 50,000 sheets a month.

stories.headline: Developers Run Laya Offline on Apple M4 via CoreML
stories.summary: A published setup demonstrates running the Laya model offline directly on Apple M4 silicon using CoreML and the Neural Engine. Leveraging a multilingual Hugging Face build, the configuration hits roughly 45 decisions per second during local testing. Developers are actively evaluating the offline performance and wiring the model into lightweight inference pipelines.

stories.headline: Houthis Strike Riyadh and Saudi Oil Infrastructure in Major Escalation
stories.summary: Yemen's Houthi militants launched drone and missile barrages hitting sensitive targets near Riyadh's international airport and Aramco facilities in Yanbu, triggering the Saudi capital's first air raid sirens in months. Smoke was documented rising from fuel depots near King Khalid International Airport following the assault, which the Houthis framed as retaliation for hundreds of Saudi airstrikes. The strikes follow fierce weekend ground fighting that killed 48 combatants as civilian displacement in Yemen topped 104,000.

stories.headline: Eritrean Political Prisoners' Children Demand Answers After 25 Years
stories.summary: Hanna Petros Solomon and her siblings have spent 25 years without news of their parents, who were arrested without trial in 2001 after signing a reform letter. Their father, former foreign minister and war hero Petros Solomon, and mother Aster Yohannes vanished following a government crackdown under President Isaias Afewerki.

stories.headline: Tech Workers Push Back Against Doomsday AI Narratives
stories.summary: Several former employees from major tech firms like OpenAI, Meta, and DeepMind are dismissing catastrophic claims that unchecked artificial intelligence will lead to human extinction. Critics of the doom narrative argue that warnings from figures like former Anthropic employee Jacob Coxon rely on vague reasoning and extreme hypothetical leaps rather than concrete proof.

stories.headline: Beck Returns to Country-Folk Roots on 'Ride Lonesome'
stories.summary: Beck channels the contemplative, acoustic-driven style of his Grammy-winning album 'Morning Phase' on his latest release, 'Ride Lonesome.' The record blends low-key country-folk songwriting and gentle West Coast rock to explore themes of isolation and alienation.

stories.headline: Matt LaFleur Faces Early Pressure Amid Packers' Sloppy Start
stories.summary: The Green Bay Packers have stumbled into an uninspiring 1-1 record to open the season, sparking questions about team execution. Head coach Matt LaFleur is facing early criticism and pressure to correct the sloppy play.

stories.headline: Chiefs vs. Colts Sunday Night Football Predictions and Betting Odds
stories.summary: A proven statistical model delivers its top predictions, odds, and point spreads for the Week 2 Sunday Night Football matchup between the Kansas City Chiefs and the Indianapolis Colts. Bettors look to data-driven insights to navigate the high-stakes primetime clash.

stories.headline: Saints Lose Left Tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. to Ankle Injury
stories.summary: New Orleans Saints left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. suffered an ankle injury during Week 2 action. The absence of the 2025 No. 9 overall draft pick deals a notable blow to the team's offensive line.

stories.headline: WorkOS Breaks Down Enterprise Single Sign-On Architecture for Developers
stories.summary: A developer guide outlines strategies for integrating enterprise single sign-on (SSO) to unlock corporate software contracts and reduce onboarding churn. The piece compares modern auth integrations to outsourced payments like Stripe, steering engineers around the legacy friction of XML and SOAP protocols. Adopting unified SSO enables engineering teams to maintain tight access controls without building authentication infrastructure from scratch.

stories.headline: Developer Turns Jev into an Impractical Chatbot
stories.summary: A developer created a tool called jevchat that forces the Jev system to operate as a language model by predicting text one symbol at a time. Built using Claude-accelerated experimentation, the setup computes probability distributions for characters and stop tokens. While functionally inefficient and costly, the interactive Python tool generates notably amusing results.

stories.headline: German Chancellor Merz Defies Calls to Resign After State Election 'Disaster'
stories.summary: Embattled German Chancellor Friedrich Merz dismissed exit polls showing historic losses for his Christian Democratic Union party in two state elections as a disaster. Despite mounting pressure and surging support for the far-right AfD, Merz vowed to remain in office and push ahead with economic reforms.

stories.headline: Deadly Moscow Drone Strikes Kill Two Amid Heavy Regional Barrage
stories.summary: An overnight Ukrainian drone attack on the Moscow region killed at least two people, injured six others, and sparked fires in residential areas and a local warehouse. Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin reported that hundreds of drones were intercepted, causing temporary flight restrictions at major airports.

stories.headline: Trump Says Planned Triumphal Arch Will Double as Military Drone Complex
stories.summary: President Donald Trump announced that his proposed 250-foot triumphal arch near Washington, D.C., will be updated to function as a military facility. According to Trump, the structure will store drones and ammunition while providing rooftop positions for snipers at the request of the U.S. military.

stories.headline: White House Blocks Reporters from CNN, MS NOW, and Politico
stories.summary: Secret Service agents deactivated and confiscated press credentials for journalists from CNN, MS NOW, and Politico following President Donald Trump's ban on the outlets. The targeted news organizations strongly condemned the decision as an unconstitutional assault on independent journalism and free speech.

stories.headline: Cultural Heritage Destruction Continues Worldwide Without Accountability
stories.summary: Recent military strikes in Ukraine and Gaza have heavily damaged protected cultural landmarks like Odesa's historic buildings and Gaza's Great Omari Mosque. Despite mounting satellite evidence and complaints filed with the International Criminal Court, no state actor has ever faced trial for destroying cultural heritage. Experts note that political roadblocks and strict jurisdictional hurdles consistently prevent legal accountability.

stories.headline: Fantasy Baseball Week 27 Sleeper Pitchers Highlighted by Jared Jones
stories.summary: The Week 27 fantasy baseball preview spotlights top sleeper pitchers to target, featuring players like Jared Jones and Walbert Urena. Managers can use these recommended start and sit options to optimize their rosters for the final stretch.

stories.headline: Barefoot Runner's Viral Sprint Spotlights India's Education Crisis
stories.summary: A 47-year-old Indian widow named Ramabai Ranveer ran a local 3km race barefoot to win prize money for her daughters' educational expenses. Her viral victory has ignited a broader national debate regarding poverty and the high costs of education in the country.

stories.headline: Soaring Childcare Costs Drive More Families to Grandparents
stories.summary: Staggering U.S. childcare expenses are forcing many parents to delay expanding their families or seek alternative support systems. In response, more grandparents are stepping in, with some relocating or retiring early to help care for their grandchildren.

stories.headline: Understanding the Fundamentals of Software Sandboxing
stories.summary: This technical guide explores the core principles of software sandboxing, focusing on programmatic privilege dropping to isolate processes securely. Drawing from Emilua development experience, it examines how applications can restrict capabilities independently of operating system file permissions.

stories.headline: Dak Prescott Claims Cowboys All-Time Passing TD Record
stories.summary: Dallas quarterback Dak Prescott has officially eclipsed Tony Romo to become the franchise leader in career passing touchdowns. Following the milestone, Prescott stated his ambition to eventually double the record before his career wraps up.

stories.headline: Pirate Face Archives AI Models via Peer-to-Peer Torrents
stories.summary: A new platform called Pirate Face is safeguarding open-source artificial intelligence models from deletion by converting them into permanent torrents. By utilizing decentralized magnet links synced directly from Hugging Face, the infrastructure ensures critical datasets and LLMs remain immune to takedowns.

stories.headline: College Football Week 4 Pressure Index Highlights Hot Seats
stories.summary: As Week 4 approaches, CBS Sports has released its latest pressure index tracking the individuals facing the most heat. The spotlight falls squarely on a handful of high-stakes coaches, quarterbacks, and coordinators whose jobs or seasons hang in the balance.

stories.headline: Apple TV Reportedly Slates Jessica Chastain's 'The Savant' for 2027
stories.summary: Jessica Chastain's upcoming drama series 'The Savant' has finally secured a release window on Apple TV. Industry reports point to an early 2027 debut for the heavily anticipated production.

stories.headline: Abandoned New Orleans Family Dollar Converted Into Free Store
stories.summary: An abandoned, graffiti-covered Family Dollar in New Orleans' Lower Ninth Ward has been transformed into a bustling free store and roller skating rink. Twice a week, local residents can line up to collect free clothing, household goods, books, and food.
